subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should #87711 remain the umbrella for Telegram reset/session-binding reliability, or should maintainers split it into narrower reset-durability, empty-delivery, diagnostics, and reset-UX issues before repair work?
rationale: The source-backed reset invariant is actionable, but the issue also asks for product-facing heartbeat, usage metadata, and warm-reset behavior that require maintainer scope before automation can safely implement them.

options.title: Keep umbrella, split repair slices
options.body: Keep #87711 open as the umbrella, land or sponsor the reset durability and missing-transcript self-heal slice first, and split delivery diagnostics and UX asks into focused follow-ups.

options.title: Narrow this issue to reset durability
options.body: Retitle and scope this issue to the store-before-header and missing-session-file invariant, moving Telegram heartbeat and warm-reset UX to new issues.

options.title: Close after live unreproducible
options.body: Only close if a current-main live Telegram topic replay proves reset, rehydration, and no-text delivery all recover visibly without operator intervention.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, split repair slices
recommendation.body: Keep #87711 open as the umbrella, land or sponsor the reset durability and missing-transcript self-heal slice first, and split delivery diagnostics and UX asks into focused follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest combined history across session store/reset architecture, Telegram/channel boundaries, and the linked thinking-level fix.
